title: Setting up a direct debit
body: You can set up a SEPA direct debit in the Alton customer portal under Payments. Changes take up to five working days to reach your bank, so an invoice issued before then is still collected the old way.

title: Double direct debit collection
body: If the same invoice was collected twice, we refund the duplicate automatically within three working days of it being flagged. You do not need to file a claim with your bank; a bank-side chargeback slows the refund down.

title: Disputing an invoice amount
body: Send the invoice number and the meter reading you believe is correct. While a dispute is open we suspend collection of the disputed amount only, not the rest of the invoice.

title: Understanding your annual statement
body: The annual statement compares what you paid in monthly instalments against what you actually consumed. A credit is transferred to your account within ten working days; a shortfall is spread across the next three instalments unless you ask to pay it at once.

title: Changing your monthly instalment
body: You can adjust your monthly instalment once per billing year in the portal. If your requested amount is more than thirty percent below our consumption forecast, we will ask you to confirm it in writing.

title: Submitting a meter reading
body: Submit readings in the portal, by email with a photo, or by phone. Readings submitted after the twenty-eighth of the month are applied to the following billing period.

title: Meter reading looks wrong
body: A reading that jumps far above your history is usually a transposed digit or a reading taken from the wrong dial. Send a photo of the meter face showing the serial number and we will correct the reading and reissue the invoice.

title: Smart meter installation
body: Smart meter installation is carried out by the local grid operator, not by Alton. Appointments are offered in four-hour windows and someone over eighteen must be present to give access.

title: Estimated readings
body: When no reading is submitted we estimate consumption from your previous twelve months. An estimate is always corrected at the next real reading, so nothing is lost or overcharged in the long run.

title: Power outage in your area
body: Outages are handled by the grid operator for your postcode, and Alton cannot restore supply directly. Check the outage map first; if your neighbours have power, the fault is likely inside your property.

title: No heating or hot water
body: If gas supply has stopped but your account is in good standing, this is a network or appliance fault. Contact the emergency number for your grid operator, and never attempt to reopen a closed gas valve yourself.

title: Smell of gas
body: Leave the building immediately, do not operate electrical switches, and call the grid operator emergency line from outside. This is not something to raise as a support ticket.

title: Disconnection and reconnection
body: Supply is only disconnected after two written reminders and a final notice. Reconnection happens within two working days of the outstanding balance clearing, and the reconnection fee is capped by regulation.

title: Switching to Alton
body: We handle the switch with your previous supplier, including the termination notice. The switch completes on the first day of a month, typically three to six weeks after signing.

title: Cancelling your contract
body: Fixed-term tariffs can be cancelled at the end of the term with four weeks notice. Outside the term, or after a price increase, you may cancel at any time with two weeks notice.

title: Price change notification
body: Price changes are announced in writing at least six weeks before they take effect. The notice triggers a special right of cancellation that you can exercise until the change takes effect.

title: Moving house
body: Tell us your move-out date and the closing meter reading at least two weeks in advance. Your contract moves with you if we supply the new address; if not, it ends on the move-out date at no charge.

title: Green tariff and origin certificates
body: The Alton Green tariff is backed by guarantees of origin for every kilowatt hour billed. Certificates for the previous year are published each March and can be downloaded from the portal.

title: Portal login problems
body: Password resets are sent to the email on the account and expire after one hour. If the reset email does not arrive, the address on file is usually an old one and has to be changed by an agent.

title: Updating your bank details
body: New bank details must be confirmed from the email address registered on the account. The change applies from the next invoice; anything already submitted to the bank is collected from the old account.

title: Adding a second person to the contract
body: A second contract holder can be added with both signatures and an identity document. Both holders are then jointly liable for the account balance.

title: Data protection and your consumption data
body: Consumption data is kept for the statutory retention period and is not shared with third parties for marketing. You can request an export of everything held on your account in the portal.
